scripts.build: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bunx turbo run build --filter=!@waifufun/sync --filter=!@waifufun/migrations --filter=!@waifufun/contracts-solana-audit
scripts.build:indexer: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bunx turbo run build --filter=!@waifufun/sync --filter=!@waifufun/migrations --filter=!@waifufun/frontend --filter=!@waifufun/contracts-solana-audit
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.clean: bunx turbo run clean --continue; rm -rf .turbo apps/api/dist apps/brain/dist apps/evm-indexer/dist apps/mcp/dist apps/worker/dist apps/sol-indexer/dist apps/frontend/out apps/frontend/.next packages/*/dist 2>/dev/null; find apps packages -type f -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.dev: ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bunx turbo run dev --parallel --continue --filter=@waifufun/frontend --filter=@waifufun/api --filter=@waifufun/worker --filter=@waifufun/evm-indexer --filter=@waifufun/brain --filter=@waifufun/mcp
scripts.dev:core: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bunx turbo run dev --parallel --continue --filter=@waifufun/api --filter=@waifufun/worker --filter=@waifufun/evm-indexer
scripts.dev:evm-indexer: ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bunx turbo run dev --filter=@waifufun/evm-indexer
scripts.dev:frontend: ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bunx turbo run dev --filter=@waifufun/frontend
scripts.dev:sol-indexer: ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bunx turbo run dev --filter=@waifufun/sol-indexer
scripts.dev:sol-indexer-windows: sh ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bunx turbo run dev --filter=@waifufun/sol-indexer
scripts.dev:windows: sh ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bunx turbo run dev --parallel --continue --filter=@waifufun/frontend --filter=@waifufun/api --filter=@waifufun/worker --filter=@waifufun/evm-indexer --filter=@waifufun/brain --filter=@waifufun/mcp
scripts.lint: NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8096" node scripts/check-tenant-id.mjs && biome check package.json turbo.json tsconfig.node.base.json biome.json && bunx turbo run lint
scripts.lint:win: set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8096&& node scripts/check-tenant-id.mjs && biome check package.json turbo.json tsconfig.node.base.json biome.json && bunx turbo run lint
scripts.migrations:build: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --filter @waifufun/migrations build
scripts.migrations:dev: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --filter @waifufun/migrations dev
scripts.migrations:start: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --filter @waifufun/migrations start
scripts.start:evm-indexer: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --filter '@waifufun/evm-indexer' start
scripts.start:sol-indexer: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --filter '@waifufun/sol-indexer' start
